regression_safety.note: These tests were already executed against code recorded by the accepted regression artifact as executable-equivalent to FINAL_STACK_COMMIT; no new test execution was possible in this validation environment.

acceptance.blocker: Final repaired stack was not executable against the frozen 22-episode historical candidate set, so strict recall, discovery recall, precision, technical false negatives and unsupported strict counts cannot be honestly established.
acceptance.next_action: Run one read-only validation job in a GitHub Actions runner from FINAL_STACK_COMMIT, loading the frozen historical monitor state/review queue snapshot into temporary paths, reclassifying without state writes or truth-source injection, then freeze only the resulting validation JSON. Do not repair, integrate, mutate DB, or deploy.
